title: When Validity Criteria Disagree: Evaluating Line-Level Explanations for Just-in-Time Defect Prediction — Replication Package
description: Author-owned software, configs, protocol freeze manifests, and compact tracked result summaries for a study of line-level attributions for a decoder-only just-in-time defect-risk classifier. Record-level license MIT applies to those author-owned materials. Raw JIT-Defects4J / JIT-Fine dumps, base LLM weights, LoRA adapters, and the manuscript PDF/LaTeX are not part of this deposit and are not relicensed. NUMERICAL_GATE = FAIL.
